Hunger Games Early Listening Party at Curious Collections

Saturday, November 7, 2026
6:00 PM – 8:00 PM

  • Admission: Free
Buy Tickets Website

Looking to hear The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping soundtrack early in Aggieland? Head to Curious Collections at The Record Garage (3901 E 29th St, Bryan, TX) on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at 6:00 PM for an official early listening party—nearly a full week before the album's November 13 release date!

Gather with the Bryan/College Station and Texas A&M vinyl community to hear the full atmospheric soundtrack on our high-fidelity speakers, enjoy exclusive official event giveaways, and pre-order your copy on vinyl or CD. Admission is free, but advance RSVPs are requested as no day-of RSVPs will be accepted.
